title: Media files
description: Upload audio, images and video for tests and lessons. The type of a file is decided by what it contains, not by its name; the length of audio and video is read from the file itself.

exam.label: Exam
exam.none: You are not an author of any exam in this context, so you cannot upload files yet.

uploader.title: Upload a file
uploader.hint: MP3, M4A, WebM, OGG audio; PNG, JPG, WebP images; MP4, WebM video. Up to {{max}} per file.

progress.label: Upload progress
progress.processing: Sent. The server is checking the file…

errors.type: This type of file is not allowed. Only MP3, M4A, WebM, OGG, PNG, JPG, WebP and MP4 are accepted. The type is decided by what the file contains.
errors.extension: The file extension does not match what the file really contains. Export it again or rename it correctly.
errors.extensionClient: The extension {{ext}} is not on the allowed list.
errors.tooLarge: The file is {{size}}, over the limit of {{max}}.
errors.serverTooLarge: The file is larger than the maximum allowed size.
errors.unreadable: The audio or video in the file could not be read (it may be damaged or cut short), so its length is unknown. Try exporting it again.
errors.empty: The file is empty. Choose a file with content.
errors.forbidden: You may not upload files for this exam in the current context.
errors.notFound: The file was not found, or you may not open it.
errors.unavailable: File storage is not available right now. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.network: The connection was lost while uploading. Check your network and try again.
errors.generic: The upload failed. Please try again.

session.title: Uploaded in this session
